function.name: give_up
function.arguments: {"reason": "Seven close attempts (from eef z=0.880 down to z=0.815, including at my best-estimate block xy) all ended in a fully-closed 0.016 gripper reading, so the pads never straddled the block; the block stayed upright on the table and was never gripped. With only 2 calls left, a grasp plus lift, traverse and release into the bowl is impossible, so the task cannot be completed within the remaining budget.", "hindsight": "Key rig facts I wish I had at the start: (1) Each move_to call only executes a few control steps (about 3-10 mm of motion) UNLESS the gripper command changes by a large amount, in which case the call runs about 80 steps (4 s) and the position servo converges to its commanded target - so pad position commands should be paired with a large gripper change (e.g. gripper 1 together with z=0.81) to actually reach a pose. (2) eef_pos sits near the fingertip/grasp-site level: commanding z=0.846 left the pads level with the block top (block top about 0.843), so a real top-down grasp needs eef z about 0.81-0.82 where the pads straddle roughly 30 mm of the block sides. (3) In the wrist view the finger-gap center is at u about 112; world +x maps to image-down (about 0.9 px/mm at 8 cm above the table) and world +y maps to image-right (about 0.85 px/mm), so lateral offsets can be measured in pixels while the object is inside the wrist frame. (4) The fixed front and side cameras both showed the gripper looking just above the block at every height and at 15-40 mm lateral offset, so they cannot be used to fine-align in x/y; only the wrist camera plus the measured eef_pos can. (5) In this scene the block sits near (x about -0.02, y about 0.015) and the blue bowl about 10 cm away at (x about +0.08, y about 0) - but the block drifts a few mm per failed close as the pads brush it, so re-verify its position in the wrist view before each attempt instead of trusting an earlier estimate. (6) Budget roughly: locate 2 calls, descend+close at least 3 calls (the z descent is slow unless padded by a gripper command), lift+traverse 2 calls, release 1 call; plan the whole placement before spending calls on probing."}
